projects.name: Verifiable Agent Audit Trail
projects.one_sentence: A tamper-evident execution ledger that binds agent inputs, tool grants, outputs, approvals, and environment evidence into replayable runs.
projects.concrete_problem: Agent transcripts omit the exact authority, artifacts, and external state needed to audit consequential actions.
projects.why_now: Agents increasingly act through tools, making plain conversation logs inadequate evidence.
projects.differentiator: Selective-disclosure Merkle proofs verify chosen claims while keeping unrelated prompts and files private.
projects.local_first_mvp: Run a mock file-editing agent, approve one write, deny network access, alter the transcript, and have the verifier pinpoint the broken chain.
projects.demo_story: A reviewer verifies that one report came from approved local files without seeing the files or unrelated prompts.
projects.test_strategy: Tamper mutation suite; proof property tests; replay equivalence; redaction leakage tests; crash-safe append tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled mock agents and tools; generated keys; no model or external service required.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Integrity does not establish truth or ethical authorization; capture must minimize personal and secret data.

projects.name: Entitlement-Aware AI Subscription Router
projects.one_sentence: A local-first planner that understands model entitlements, usage counters, reset windows, privacy constraints, and task requirements across subscriptions.
projects.concrete_problem: People pay for overlapping AI plans but cannot tell which included model should handle a task or when quotas reset.
projects.why_now: Model capabilities and plan limits change quickly while per-call routing tools assume API billing.
projects.differentiator: It models subscriptions as temporal entitlements, imports usage locally, and explains a Pareto-optimal route without needing provider API keys.
projects.local_first_mvp: Load three synthetic plan snapshots and usage logs, classify ten task cards, and reroute work as one plan nears a rolling reset limit.
projects.demo_story: A long-context task moves to an already-paid plan while a scarce reasoning quota is preserved for a proof task.
projects.test_strategy: Golden reset-window cases; property tests for quota conservation; route optimality checks; stale-entitlement warnings.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled synthetic plans plus manual CSV/JSON import; no provider login, scraping, paid API, or secret.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Never automates account access or claims current provider terms without a dated user-supplied snapshot.

projects.name: Screen Reader Regression Lab
projects.one_sentence: A deterministic accessibility harness that records semantic UI trees and replays keyboard/screen-reader workflows across builds.
projects.concrete_problem: Visual snapshots miss focus order, announcements, landmarks, and state changes that break nonvisual use.
projects.why_now: Component-heavy web apps change accessibility behavior without visible diffs.
projects.differentiator: It compares semantic event traces and task completion, not raw DOM or pixels.
projects.local_first_mvp: Replay login and menu tasks against two bundled local pages and catch a focus trap plus missing live-region announcement.
projects.demo_story: A visually identical release fails because focus disappears after a modal closes; the trace pinpoints the transition.
projects.test_strategy: Known accessible/inaccessible fixtures; event-order tolerance tests; keyboard-only end-to-end runs; diff goldens.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local HTML fixtures and browser accessibility APIs; no cloud service.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Automated checks complement, never replace, testing by disabled users.

projects.name: Counterfactual Prediction-Market AMM
projects.one_sentence: An event-replay simulator for prediction-market AMMs with counterfactual order execution, fees, liquidity, and resolution rules.
projects.concrete_problem: Market histories show realized prices but not how alternative liquidity or execution policies would have changed outcomes.
projects.why_now: Event markets are growing while mechanism behavior remains poorly understood.
projects.differentiator: A deterministic limit-order and LMSR-style engine replays public/synthetic events under alternate policies without trading money.
projects.local_first_mvp: Replay a bundled 5,000-event market, branch before a liquidity shock, and compare slippage, maker loss, and calibration under two mechanisms.
projects.demo_story: The same information shock produces very different trader costs and subsidy exposure after one liquidity-policy change.
projects.test_strategy: Conservation invariants; hand-calculated executions; deterministic replay hashes; property tests for no-arbitrage bounds.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled synthetic event logs and optional openly licensed CSV; no brokerage, wallet, paid API, or secret.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Educational simulation only; no execution, personalized betting advice, or claims of profit.

projects.name: Agent Tool Permission Broker
projects.one_sentence: A capability broker that converts agent tool requests into least-privilege, expiring grants with human-readable risk previews.
projects.concrete_problem: Agents commonly receive broad filesystem or shell access for a task requiring only one narrow operation.
projects.why_now: Tool-use is advancing faster than permission models designed for autonomous sequences.
projects.differentiator: Grants are scoped to objects and predicates, not tool names, and can require step-up approval only when risk changes.
projects.local_first_mvp: Mediate a mock agent that may read one project tree and write one output file while blocking symlink escapes and network calls.
projects.demo_story: A routine write proceeds silently, but a symlink changes its destination and triggers a precise step-up prompt.
projects.test_strategy: Adversarial path corpus; token attenuation properties; race tests; policy decision tables.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local mock tools and filesystem fixtures only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: The broker complements OS sandboxing and must not be advertised as an escape-proof boundary.

projects.name: Semantic Merge Engine
projects.one_sentence: A syntax-aware three-way merge engine that preserves program structure and explains residual conflicts.
projects.concrete_problem: Line merges produce noisy conflicts when two branches independently move, rename, or edit the same declaration.
projects.why_now: Large parallel and agent-generated change sets make merge quality a daily bottleneck.
projects.differentiator: It matches declarations by identity and edit intent, then validates the merged AST before emitting code.
projects.local_first_mvp: Merge TypeScript branches that rename a function and edit its body, resolving the change that Git marks conflicting.
projects.demo_story: The tool auto-merges a moved-and-edited function and isolates one true semantic conflict.
projects.test_strategy: Corpus of real merge triples; round-trip AST tests; differential comparison with Git; mutation tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled repositories and local parsers only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Never overwrites working files without a preview and syntax/type validation.

projects.name: Home Energy Tariff Simulator
projects.one_sentence: A local optimizer comparing appliance schedules, batteries, and rate plans against interval energy use and comfort constraints.
projects.concrete_problem: Monthly totals cannot show whether a time-of-use plan or load shift actually saves money.
projects.why_now: Dynamic rates, heat pumps, EVs, and batteries make timing economically important.
projects.differentiator: It separates behavioral shifts from equipment investments and reports uncertainty under weather/load scenarios.
projects.local_first_mvp: Optimize a synthetic home's EV and water-heater schedule across three tariffs and verify bill calculations.
projects.demo_story: A cheaper-looking rate loses after demand charges; a small schedule change wins without new hardware.
projects.test_strategy: Hand-calculated bills; solver feasibility; tariff boundary cases; sensitivity sweeps.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic or user-exported interval CSV and manually entered tariffs.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Never control safety-critical loads; recommendations are estimates, not utility guarantees.

projects.name: Citation Claim Graph
projects.one_sentence: A local research reader that links atomic claims to exact cited spans and flags unsupported citation chains.
projects.concrete_problem: Reference lists show sources but not which source span supports which sentence or whether citation chains distort claims.
projects.why_now: AI-assisted synthesis makes claim-level provenance essential.
projects.differentiator: The graph distinguishes direct evidence, paraphrase, background, contradiction, and citation-by-proxy.
projects.local_first_mvp: Analyze a bundled five-paper corpus and reveal one claim supported only by a misquoted secondary citation.
projects.demo_story: Clicking a sentence traverses two papers to show the original result is narrower than the paraphrase.
projects.test_strategy: Hand-labeled claim/span set; resolver goldens; graph consistency; reviewer agreement.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Open/bundled papers; optional local model.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Automated support labels are triage aids and must not accuse authors of misconduct.

projects.name: Hybrid Retrieval Engine
projects.one_sentence: A local search engine that fuses lexical, vector, freshness, and structured filters with explainable ranking.
projects.concrete_problem: Vector-only search misses exact identifiers while keyword search misses paraphrases.
projects.why_now: Small local embeddings make private hybrid retrieval practical.
projects.differentiator: Every result decomposes its score and supports counterfactual weight tuning.
projects.local_first_mvp: Index 10,000 bundled/open documents and beat lexical and vector baselines on a judged query set.
projects.demo_story: A query containing an exact error code and a paraphrase retrieves the right incident for explainable reasons.
projects.test_strategy: Recall/latency benchmarks; index mutation properties; ranking goldens; crash recovery.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Open corpora or bundled fixtures; optional local embedding model.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Surface source provenance and deletion; never treat similarity as factual support.

projects.name: Local Privacy Egress Gateway
projects.one_sentence: A loopback proxy that discovers, classifies, redacts, and policy-checks sensitive outbound data before it leaves a device.
projects.concrete_problem: Desktop tools and local agents can silently send secrets or personal data to destinations users did not intend.
projects.why_now: Tool-using agents and numerous SaaS clients have greatly expanded the device's outbound data surface.
projects.differentiator: Decisions are explainable, destination-aware, and backed by a local evidence ledger rather than a binary blocklist.
projects.local_first_mvp: Route a sample CLI through the proxy, detect seeded API keys and health data in JSON, redact allowed fields, and block an unapproved destination.
projects.demo_story: A mock agent tries to upload a secret; the gateway blocks it, explains the rule, and safely permits the redacted retry.
projects.test_strategy: Golden redaction corpus; chunk-boundary fuzzing; policy decision tables; encrypted-ledger tamper tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Runs against a bundled local echo server and synthetic sensitive-data fixtures; no certificate service or secret.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Does not claim perfect DLP; HTTPS interception must be explicit and scoped to opted-in clients.

projects.name: Network Policy Model Checker
projects.one_sentence: A verifier that computes effective reachability and minimal counterexamples across layered firewall, service-mesh, and application policies.
projects.concrete_problem: Individually plausible allow/deny rules compose into unexpected paths or outages.
projects.why_now: Zero-trust environments multiply independently managed policy layers.
projects.differentiator: It reasons over identity, ports, direction, and rule precedence and returns a packet-level witness.
projects.local_first_mvp: Verify bundled Kubernetes-like policies and expose a path opened only by namespace and egress rule composition.
projects.demo_story: A service marked isolated is reachable through a three-hop identity path rendered as one concrete flow.
projects.test_strategy: Truth-table fixtures; property-based policy generation; solver cross-checks; mutation tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local policy files and synthetic inventories.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Read-only analysis; absence of a modeled path is not proof against unmodeled infrastructure.

projects.name: Reproducible Paper Runner
projects.one_sentence: A local artifact harness that rebuilds a paper's figures from declared data, code, environment, and seeds.
projects.concrete_problem: Research artifacts often run once but cannot prove which inputs produced each published result.
projects.why_now: Artifact evaluation is growing across conferences and journals.
projects.differentiator: Each figure receives a provenance DAG, environment fingerprint, and byte/numeric comparison to the reference.
projects.local_first_mvp: Reproduce two bundled figures, then identify a seed and dependency change that alter one result.
projects.demo_story: A figure looks identical but the runner catches statistically meaningful numeric drift.
projects.test_strategy: Known reproducible/broken artifacts; seed matrix; provenance integrity; sandbox tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled/open artifacts with cached dependencies.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Respect licenses and resource limits; reproducibility does not validate scientific conclusions.

projects.name: Deterministic Chaos Cluster
projects.one_sentence: A miniature replicated key-value cluster whose network, clocks, disks, and scheduler can be faulted and replayed exactly.
projects.concrete_problem: Distributed failures are difficult to reproduce because timing and message order disappear after a test run.
projects.why_now: Reliable services increasingly depend on consensus, while most student projects only exercise happy paths.
projects.differentiator: Every nondeterministic choice becomes a seeded event log that can be minimized into a small failing schedule.
projects.local_first_mvp: Run three local processes, inject a partition during concurrent writes, detect a stale read, then replay the identical 30-event trace from one seed.
projects.demo_story: A user breaks the cluster with one click, watches leadership split, and reruns the exact counterexample after a code fix.
projects.test_strategy: Property-test generated histories; model-check small schedules; crash/restart at every persisted step; verify replay hashes.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Uses generated commands and local sockets only; no external data, account, or secret.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Fault injection is bound to loopback and disposable data directories by default.

projects.name: Agent Regression Simulator
projects.one_sentence: A deterministic environment simulator that evaluates agent policies against versioned world states, delayed tools, and injected failures.
projects.concrete_problem: Agent evaluations over live tools are costly, irreproducible, and unable to exercise rare dangerous states.
projects.why_now: Tool-using systems need regression tests beyond static question-answer datasets.
projects.differentiator: Scenario worlds expose stateful consequences and branchable counterfactuals while remaining model-provider neutral.
projects.local_first_mvp: Evaluate scripted and local-model agents on a filesystem support scenario with stale reads, failed writes, and an approval gate.
projects.demo_story: A policy that scores perfectly on happy paths corrupts state after a delayed retry; the trace becomes a permanent regression.
projects.test_strategy: Golden trajectories; simulator determinism hashes; metamorphic scenarios; scorer consistency tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Scripted baselines and local models; no external model required.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Synthetic scores must not be presented as real-world safety certification.

projects.name: Benchmark Leakage Detector
projects.one_sentence: A corpus forensic tool that finds exact, semantic, and transformation-derived overlap across training and evaluation splits.
projects.concrete_problem: Benchmark scores are inflated by duplicates, paraphrases, templated variants, and answer-bearing metadata.
projects.why_now: Large reused corpora make contamination increasingly hard to audit.
projects.differentiator: It detects a hierarchy of leakage mechanisms and emits inspectable evidence pairs with uncertainty.
projects.local_first_mvp: Scan two bundled 50,000-item corpora and recover seeded exact, paraphrase, and metadata leaks.
projects.demo_story: A clean exact-dedupe report hides a templated answer leak that explains an anomalous score jump.
projects.test_strategy: Seeded contamination corpus; precision/recall; ablations; deterministic indexing.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic/open corpora and optional local embeddings.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Similarity is not proof of misconduct; honor dataset licenses and privacy.

projects.name: Flaky Test Causality
projects.one_sentence: A test runner that perturbs scheduling, order, clocks, and resources, then minimizes the condition that makes a test flaky.
projects.concrete_problem: Rerunning flaky tests measures symptoms but rarely identifies the hidden shared state or timing dependency.
projects.why_now: Parallel CI and asynchronous code increase nondeterministic failures.
projects.differentiator: It searches a perturbation space and returns a minimal causal recipe, not just a failure frequency.
projects.local_first_mvp: Expose an order-dependent and a timer-dependent test in a bundled suite and minimize each to one reproducible command.
projects.demo_story: A 1-in-50 failure becomes a deterministic two-test order plus a 20ms clock jump.
projects.test_strategy: Known flaky fixtures; seeded repeatability; false-causality controls; adapter contract tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Runs local test suites; CI import is optional.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Resource perturbations run in isolated child processes with explicit limits.

projects.name: Migration Rehearsal Harness
projects.one_sentence: A database-change simulator that replays production-shaped traffic against staged schema migrations and rollback plans.
projects.concrete_problem: Migrations that succeed on a snapshot may still lock tables, break old binaries, or make rollback impossible.
projects.why_now: Continuous deployment requires old and new application versions to overlap safely.
projects.differentiator: It validates expand-contract compatibility across version mixtures and injects failures at every migration phase.
projects.local_first_mvp: Rehearse a PostgreSQL-like migration in local SQLite/DuckDB fixtures and catch an old-client write lost after premature column removal.
projects.demo_story: The forward migration passes, but a forced rollback exposes a non-reversible data transform.
projects.test_strategy: Migration pattern corpus; mixed-client matrix; kill-point injection; invariant snapshots.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic schemas and generated traffic; no production database required.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Defaults to disposable databases and cannot connect to non-loopback hosts without an override.

projects.name: Notebook Provenance Kernel
projects.one_sentence: A notebook runtime that records cell dependencies, hidden state, data versions, and execution order to produce reproducible outputs.
projects.concrete_problem: Notebooks can display results impossible to recreate from top-to-bottom execution.
projects.why_now: Notebooks remain central to research despite persistent hidden-state failures.
projects.differentiator: It discovers runtime dependencies and generates the smallest clean execution plan for any output.
projects.local_first_mvp: Run a bundled Python notebook out of order, mark stale outputs, and rebuild one chart in a clean process.
projects.demo_story: A chart that looked current is traced to a deleted variable from an earlier kernel state.
projects.test_strategy: Hidden-state fixtures; clean-run equivalence; mutation cases; snapshot recovery.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local notebooks and small bundled datasets.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Instrumented code executes in a sandbox and captures no secrets by default.

projects.name: Semantic Filesystem Index
projects.one_sentence: A private incremental index that answers structural and semantic questions across local files with source-grounded results.
projects.concrete_problem: Desktop search cannot combine file structure, exact symbols, extracted text, and meaning while remaining private.
projects.why_now: Local embedding runtimes make useful private search possible on consumer hardware.
projects.differentiator: Filesystem events update multiple indexes transactionally and every result cites an exact local span.
projects.local_first_mvp: Index a synthetic project and document folder, rename/edit files, and answer mixed code/prose queries with stable citations.
projects.demo_story: A concept query finds a design note and the exact function that implements it after both were renamed.
projects.test_strategy: Mutation/update tests; ranking judgments; permission fixtures; citation validity checks.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local files and optional local model only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Respect filesystem permissions, exclusions, and immediate deletion from derived indexes.

projects.name: Adaptive Trace Tail Sampler
projects.one_sentence: A local collector that retains rare and high-value traces under a fixed storage budget using streaming sketches.
projects.concrete_problem: Head sampling drops rare failures while naive tail sampling consumes unbounded memory.
projects.why_now: High-cardinality traces outgrow uniform retention budgets.
projects.differentiator: Sampling policies expose inclusion probabilities so downstream estimates remain correctable.
projects.local_first_mvp: Process a generated million-span stream, retain rare errors under 100MB, and estimate global latency with confidence bounds.
projects.demo_story: A 0.01-percent failure survives while routine traces shrink, without destroying aggregate estimates.
projects.test_strategy: Ground-truth streams; memory hard limits; probability calibration; late-span fuzzing.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Generated OTLP-like data; no backend.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Attribute allowlists and retention limits prevent sensitive trace hoarding.

projects.name: Microgrid Outage Simulator
projects.one_sentence: A discrete-time planner for allocating solar, battery, generator, and flexible loads during multi-day grid outages.
projects.concrete_problem: Backup systems are sized by energy totals that ignore timing, uncertainty, startup power, and critical-load priorities.
projects.why_now: Longer outages and distributed energy resources increase local resilience planning needs.
projects.differentiator: It optimizes survival probability across weather/outage scenarios and explains each shed-load decision.
projects.local_first_mvp: Simulate a clinic-like synthetic facility over 72 hours and compare greedy versus robust dispatch.
projects.demo_story: Saving battery early preserves refrigeration through a cloudy second day that greedy dispatch misses.
projects.test_strategy: Energy conservation; analytic schedules; solver feasibility; Monte Carlo repeatability.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic loads and open weather files.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Not electrical design or emergency operating instructions; real systems need engineers and codes.

projects.name: Capability Plugin Sandbox
projects.one_sentence: A WASI-based plugin host that grants narrowly scoped filesystem, network, clock, and secret capabilities with revocable leases.
projects.concrete_problem: Extensible desktop tools often load third-party plugins with the full authority of the host process.
projects.why_now: Agent tools and community extensions are multiplying faster than users can audit them.
projects.differentiator: Capabilities are object-scoped, time-bounded, inspectable, and replayable in a deterministic policy test harness.
projects.local_first_mvp: Run an untrusted sample plugin that can read one file and call one local endpoint while denied access to sibling paths and the public network.
projects.demo_story: A malicious plugin enumerates the home directory and exfiltrates data, but every unauthorized operation is denied and explained.
projects.test_strategy: Adversarial plugin corpus; syscall coverage tests; path traversal fuzzing; lease-expiry race tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled WebAssembly fixtures and loopback servers only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: The sandbox should be described as defense in depth until independently audited for escapes.

projects.name: Causal Event Replay Debugger
projects.one_sentence: A recorder that reconstructs happens-before relationships across local services and replays only the causal slice behind a failure.
projects.concrete_problem: Timestamp-sorted logs obscure causality when retries, queues, and clock skew interact.
projects.why_now: Event-driven systems are common, but production-grade causal debugging remains inaccessible for small projects.
projects.differentiator: It derives vector-clock edges from trace context and message fingerprints, then emits a minimal executable replay.
projects.local_first_mvp: Instrument three toy services, trigger a duplicate-delivery bug, and replay the smallest causal subgraph that reproduces it.
projects.demo_story: Instead of reading 20,000 log lines, the user receives a 14-event chain and reruns the bug locally.
projects.test_strategy: Generate DAGs with known ancestry; fuzz skew and duplicates; compare replay outcomes; snapshot redaction behavior.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic services and local traces are sufficient; optional OpenTelemetry files require no collector credential.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Sensitive fields must be redacted at capture time and raw payload retention must be opt-in.

projects.name: Context Provenance Compiler
projects.one_sentence: A compiler that assembles agent context from local sources while preserving claim-level lineage, freshness, and access policy.
projects.concrete_problem: Retrieved context is flattened into text, losing which source supports a claim and whether it is stale or unauthorized.
projects.why_now: Long-context models make it easy to include more material but not to preserve evidence quality.
projects.differentiator: The output is a typed context package with provenance edges and invalidation rules, not a prompt string.
projects.local_first_mvp: Compile a local document set into a constrained context bundle and reject a generated answer whose citation no longer supports its claim.
projects.demo_story: Shrinking context saves tokens while every retained sentence still points to a valid source span.
projects.test_strategy: Provenance graph properties; citation entailment fixtures; stale-source simulations; budget determinism.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled documents and optional local embedding/model runtimes; no paid API.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Support checks express evidence linkage, not universal truth; access labels must propagate.

projects.name: Double-Entry Reconciliation Engine
projects.one_sentence: A local ledger that infers transfer pairs, enforces accounting invariants, and explains unresolved statement discrepancies.
projects.concrete_problem: Personal and small-organization exports duplicate transfers and silently drift from real balances.
projects.why_now: Users can export data but lack trustworthy local reconciliation.
projects.differentiator: Every inferred match has a confidence proof and all books remain balanced through explicit suspense accounts.
projects.local_first_mvp: Import synthetic statements from three institutions, resolve transfers and fees, and balance to known closing totals.
projects.demo_story: A missing $2 fee explains a month-long imbalance and is converted into an auditable entry.
projects.test_strategy: Accounting conservation properties; generated statement pairs; ambiguous-match cases; import idempotence.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic fixtures and manual local exports; no bank login.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Financial records stay local and suggestions require confirmation; not tax advice.

projects.name: Exactly-Once Stream Lab
projects.one_sentence: A compact stream processor that implements checkpoints, replay, deduplication, and transactional sinks under crashes.
projects.concrete_problem: Exactly-once claims are hard to understand because sources, operators, and sinks fail at different boundaries.
projects.why_now: Real-time pipelines are common, but their delivery guarantees are frequently misconfigured.
projects.differentiator: A guarantee explorer proves when output is at-most-once, at-least-once, or effectively exactly-once for each failure trace.
projects.local_first_mvp: Aggregate a local click stream, crash at every checkpoint phase, recover, and verify the sink has neither missing nor duplicated windows.
projects.demo_story: The user drags a crash point through a timeline and watches guarantees change with or without a transactional sink.
projects.test_strategy: Crash-point enumeration; reference-model comparison; property tests for duplicate suppression; load/backpressure tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Generated event logs and SQLite only; no cloud broker required.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Documentation must avoid overstating guarantees outside the modeled source and sink contracts.

projects.name: Packet Replay Digital Twin
projects.one_sentence: A deterministic network-service twin that replays packet captures through modeled latency, loss, NAT, and protocol state.
projects.concrete_problem: Packet captures show symptoms but cannot safely answer what would happen under a different network condition.
projects.why_now: Distributed apps increasingly fail only under specific edge-network behavior.
projects.differentiator: Counterfactual replay preserves protocol causality while substituting controlled network policies.
projects.local_first_mvp: Replay a bundled HTTP trace, inject loss and NAT timeout, and reproduce a retry amplification failure.
projects.demo_story: The same traffic succeeds on baseline and melts down when one NAT timeout is shortened.
projects.test_strategy: Known protocol traces; deterministic hashes; packet mutation fuzzing; emulator parity.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled synthetic PCAPs and loopback emulators.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Redact captures and prohibit replay to public destinations by default.

projects.name: Algorithm Misconception Debugger
projects.one_sentence: A tutor engine that diagnoses algorithmic misconceptions from execution traces rather than marking only final answers.
projects.concrete_problem: Wrong answers from different misconceptions receive the same feedback.
projects.why_now: Automated grading needs deeper feedback without opaque answer generation.
projects.differentiator: Buggy strategy models predict trace-level errors and return a minimal counterexample plus targeted prompt.
projects.local_first_mvp: Diagnose five common binary-search and graph-traversal misconceptions from submitted local functions.
projects.demo_story: Two wrong BFS outputs receive different tiny graphs that expose queue-order versus visited-set errors.
projects.test_strategy: Seeded buggy implementations; diagnosis precision; counterexample minimality; instructor review.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled exercises and synthetic submissions.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Avoid punitive profiling; diagnoses are tentative and visible to students.

projects.name: API Compatibility Oracle
projects.one_sentence: A contract analyzer that combines schema diffing and generated clients to prove whether an API change breaks real call shapes.
projects.concrete_problem: Schema-level breaking-change rules overreport harmless edits and miss behavioral incompatibilities.
projects.why_now: Rapidly generated clients magnify subtle compatibility errors.
projects.differentiator: It synthesizes boundary requests against old and new local servers and stores executable counterexamples.
projects.local_first_mvp: Compare two bundled API versions and find a nullable-field change missed by a textual diff.
projects.demo_story: A green schema diff turns red when a generated old client receives a newly invalid response.
projects.test_strategy: Known compatibility matrix; property-based payload generation; dual-run determinism; minimized golden cases.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local specifications and stub servers only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Generated requests never target non-loopback hosts without explicit opt-in.

projects.name: Food Rescue Routing Lab
projects.one_sentence: A pickup-and-delivery optimizer for perishable donations with time windows, cold-chain limits, fairness, and uncertain supply.
projects.concrete_problem: Naive shortest routes can spoil food or repeatedly underserve distant recipients.
projects.why_now: Food waste and food insecurity coexist while volunteer logistics remain constrained.
projects.differentiator: Routes optimize rescued nutrition and equitable service under uncertainty, not merely miles.
projects.local_first_mvp: Route synthetic donations among 30 sites and compare distance-only with spoilage- and fairness-aware plans.
projects.demo_story: A slightly longer route saves more usable meals and reaches a previously skipped site.
projects.test_strategy: Solver feasibility; conservation/spoilage; exact small cases; scenario stress.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic locations and offline open street extracts optional.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Protect recipient locations and defer food-safety rules to qualified organizations.

projects.name: Payment Routing Simulator
projects.one_sentence: A graph simulator that routes payments across rails under fees, failure rates, settlement delay, limits, and liquidity.
projects.concrete_problem: Cheapest-path routing fails when rails have correlated outages, limits, retries, and delayed settlement.
projects.why_now: Applications increasingly orchestrate multiple instant and traditional payment rails.
projects.differentiator: Routes optimize expected total cost while reserving liquidity and modeling retry-induced duplicates.
projects.local_first_mvp: Route 10,000 synthetic payments across five rails and outperform cheapest-first during a seeded outage.
projects.demo_story: A slightly costlier route prevents cascading retry fees and a liquidity shortfall.
projects.test_strategy: Money conservation; graph oracle cases; seeded failure simulations; duplicate-settlement tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic rails and transactions only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: No real payment initiation; assumptions must be reviewed before operational use.

projects.name: Runtime Dependency Inference
projects.one_sentence: A passive local analyzer that infers service dependencies and retry edges from traces without a service registry.
projects.concrete_problem: Architecture maps miss runtime fan-out, queues, and retry loops that drive incidents.
projects.why_now: Ephemeral services and async messaging make static diagrams stale quickly.
projects.differentiator: Edges carry confidence, causal evidence, and versioned change history rather than pretending topology is certain.
projects.local_first_mvp: Infer a hidden queue consumer and retry cycle from bundled OpenTelemetry JSON and compare two deployment snapshots.
projects.demo_story: A supposedly isolated service is linked to checkout through a low-volume asynchronous path.
projects.test_strategy: Synthetic ground-truth graphs; missing-span tests; calibration curves; temporal diff goldens.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local open-format traces only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Hash sensitive attributes and present inferred edges with uncertainty.

projects.name: Schema Evolution Proofkit
projects.one_sentence: A verifier that checks whether serialized data remains readable across producer and consumer version graphs.
projects.concrete_problem: Pairwise schema checks miss rolling deployments and records written by intermediate versions.
projects.why_now: Long-lived event logs outlast application versions.
projects.differentiator: It explores version mixtures and generates the shortest payload witnessing incompatibility.
projects.local_first_mvp: Check five bundled Avro-like schemas and find a three-version rolling-upgrade failure missed by adjacent comparisons.
projects.demo_story: All adjacent versions pass, yet the proofkit finds an old record that the newest reader corrupts.
projects.test_strategy: Official-style conformance vectors; generated schemas; mutation testing; witness replay.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local schemas and generated payloads.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Supported format semantics and assumptions must be explicit.

projects.name: Accessible Document Remediator
projects.one_sentence: A structure-aware linter that detects and safely repairs reading order, headings, tables, labels, and contrast in office/PDF-like documents.
projects.concrete_problem: Accessibility checkers list defects but leave authors unable to repair document structure confidently.
projects.why_now: Digital accessibility obligations increasingly apply to everyday generated documents.
projects.differentiator: Repairs are proposed as reversible structural patches with before/after semantic-tree previews.
projects.local_first_mvp: Lint and repair a bundled malformed document, then verify keyboard order and semantic structure in an exported artifact.
projects.demo_story: A visually correct table becomes navigable after an explainable header-association patch.
projects.test_strategy: Known defect corpus; round-trip rendering; semantic-tree snapshots; manual assistive-tech checklist.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled local documents; no conversion API.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Generated alt text and ambiguous reading order always require author review.

projects.name: Artifact Provenance Verifier
projects.one_sentence: A local verifier that traces a release artifact through source commit, dependency locks, build recipe, and signed attestation.
projects.concrete_problem: Checksums confirm bytes but not whether those bytes came from the reviewed source and declared toolchain.
projects.why_now: Dependency compromise and opaque CI make provenance a practical requirement beyond large enterprises.
projects.differentiator: It can rebuild tiny projects in a hermetic local sandbox and report the first byte-level provenance divergence.
projects.local_first_mvp: Build a bundled package twice, verify its signed statement, then introduce a timestamp and pinpoint the non-reproducible archive member.
projects.demo_story: A release passes its checksum but fails provenance because one dependency differs from the reviewed lockfile.
projects.test_strategy: Known-good and forged attestations; reproducibility fixtures; signature mutation tests; sandbox escape regression suite.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Uses bundled repositories, local keys, and cached packages; network access is unnecessary for the demo.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Trust policies and local keys are clearly separated from production roots; verification is not certification.

projects.name: Deterministic Build Explainer
projects.one_sentence: A build tracer that identifies which undeclared input made two supposedly identical local builds differ.
projects.concrete_problem: Non-reproducible builds are usually blamed on timestamps without evidence of the actual dependency path.
projects.why_now: Supply-chain verification depends on reproducible outputs.
projects.differentiator: It correlates syscall-level reads with structured binary diffs to explain the first causal divergence.
projects.local_first_mvp: Build a bundled C project twice under varied time and locale, then attribute differing bytes to one undeclared input.
projects.demo_story: A one-byte binary difference expands into the exact environment read and build step responsible.
projects.test_strategy: Seeded nondeterminism fixtures; syscall coverage tests; artifact hash checks; platform matrix.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local fixtures and toolchains only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Tracing is scoped to child processes and redacts environment secrets.

projects.name: Durable Workflow Kernel
projects.one_sentence: A local workflow runtime that survives process death by replaying deterministic orchestration history while isolating side effects.
projects.concrete_problem: Long-running jobs become tangled retry scripts when crashes occur between a side effect and its recorded completion.
projects.why_now: Agentic and data workflows increasingly require durable, inspectable execution rather than ephemeral task queues.
projects.differentiator: The kernel detects nondeterministic workflow-code changes and provides explicit compensation semantics.
projects.local_first_mvp: Run an order-like workflow with a timer and three activities, kill the runtime after each step, and resume exactly once from SQLite.
projects.demo_story: A workflow resumes after a forced crash, then the debugger flags a code edit that would diverge from recorded history.
projects.test_strategy: Kill-point matrix; replay determinism tests; fake-clock timer tests; activity idempotency properties.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Ships with local mock activities; integrations are optional adapters.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Side-effect adapters must document idempotency keys and irreversible actions require explicit confirmation.

projects.name: Bitemporal Embedded Store
projects.one_sentence: An embedded database that records both when facts were true and when the system learned them.
projects.concrete_problem: Ordinary audit columns cannot correctly answer historical questions after late corrections.
projects.why_now: Auditable local applications need explainable history without enterprise infrastructure.
projects.differentiator: SQL-like queries expose valid-time and transaction-time semantics with correction lineage.
projects.local_first_mvp: Import a synthetic account ledger, backdate a correction, and answer what was believed versus true on two dates.
projects.demo_story: One query explains why last month's report differed from today's corrected view.
projects.test_strategy: Reference-model queries; interval boundary properties; crash recovery; compaction equivalence.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Generated records and local files only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: History retention may preserve sensitive corrections; support explicit encrypted deletion policies.

projects.name: Concurrency Schedule Explorer
projects.one_sentence: A controlled runtime that enumerates and minimizes thread or async schedules that violate user-supplied invariants.
projects.concrete_problem: Concurrency bugs evade tests because the failing interleaving is rare and unrecoverable.
projects.why_now: Async code and multicore execution are default even in small applications.
projects.differentiator: Dynamic partial-order reduction avoids equivalent schedules and outputs a replayable witness.
projects.local_first_mvp: Find and replay a lost-update bug in a four-task async program while pruning equivalent schedules.
projects.demo_story: A race that almost never appears is reduced to six deterministic scheduling decisions.
projects.test_strategy: Known litmus tests; exhaustive small programs; trace-replay hashes; reduction soundness comparisons.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled programs and local runtime only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Instrumented execution is not a production performance profile.

projects.name: Data Egress Policy Compiler
projects.one_sentence: A static and dynamic analyzer that compiles human-readable data-handling rules into checks over program egress paths.
projects.concrete_problem: Privacy policies describe allowed flows, but code review rarely proves where sensitive fields can actually leave.
projects.why_now: Regulated data now flows through SDK-heavy applications and agent tools with hard-to-see propagation.
projects.differentiator: It combines lightweight taint analysis with runtime labels and returns a source-to-sink proof path.
projects.local_first_mvp: Analyze a bundled TypeScript service, identify an email field reaching an unapproved HTTP sink, and verify a compliant redaction fix.
projects.demo_story: A harmless-looking analytics call expands into the exact five-function path that leaks a user identifier.
projects.test_strategy: Curated vulnerable/safe fixtures; mutation testing of sanitizers; soundness checks on a supported language subset.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled source fixtures and a loopback sink; no external service.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Reports supported-language limits and avoids presenting absence of findings as proof of absence.

projects.name: Offline AAC Composer
projects.one_sentence: A private augmentative-communication composer that predicts phrases from a user-owned vocabulary and conversational state on-device.
projects.concrete_problem: AAC users need fast personalized phrasing, but cloud prediction creates latency and privacy risks.
projects.why_now: Compact local models can personalize language on commodity devices.
projects.differentiator: The system optimizes access effort and preserves user voice with editable provenance for every suggestion.
projects.local_first_mvp: Use a bundled synthetic vocabulary to compose ten scenario phrases offline with keyboard and switch-scanning modes.
projects.demo_story: A six-selection phrase becomes two selections while still using the speaker's preferred wording.
projects.test_strategy: Keystroke savings; latency budgets; offline guarantees; accessibility task testing.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled vocabulary and optional tiny local model; no cloud speech service.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: User controls learning, deletion, and final speech; never impersonate or speak without confirmation.

projects.name: Agent Checkpoint Debugger
projects.one_sentence: A time-travel debugger for stateful agents that snapshots memory, tool state, random seeds, and pending approvals at each decision.
projects.concrete_problem: When a long agent run diverges, developers cannot branch from the decisive step without repeating costly earlier work.
projects.why_now: Long-horizon agents make full reruns slow and nondeterministic.
projects.differentiator: Forked runs use copy-on-write world state and display a semantic diff of memory and tool effects.
projects.local_first_mvp: Run a mock support agent, branch before a bad decision, change one observation, and compare resulting tool effects.
projects.demo_story: A 30-step failure is repaired by forking step 21 without rerunning the first 20 tool calls.
projects.test_strategy: Restore equivalence; branch isolation; snapshot corruption recovery; version-migration fixtures.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled deterministic agents and mock tools; no model API.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Snapshots may contain sensitive context and require encryption, retention controls, and redaction.

projects.name: Architecture Boundary Guard
projects.one_sentence: A repository analyzer that learns module boundaries and enforces dependency, ownership, and data-flow constraints in code review.
projects.concrete_problem: Layering diagrams drift because import checks cannot capture factories, events, generated code, or sensitive data paths.
projects.why_now: AI-assisted edits can cross architectural boundaries faster than reviewers notice.
projects.differentiator: Rules operate on a unified semantic graph and each violation includes the shortest dependency path.
projects.local_first_mvp: Index a bundled monorepo and catch a domain layer reaching infrastructure through an event-handler indirection.
projects.demo_story: A harmless import reveals a six-edge path from payment data to an analytics package.
projects.test_strategy: Synthetic architecture fixtures; resolver parity tests; incremental/full equivalence; rule mutation tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local source trees only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Learned boundaries are suggestions until explicitly accepted by maintainers.

projects.name: Building Retrofit Planner
projects.one_sentence: A physics-informed local planner that ranks insulation, HVAC, sealing, and control upgrades under budget and comfort constraints.
projects.concrete_problem: Simple payback calculators ignore interactions among upgrades, weather, comfort, and equipment sizing.
projects.why_now: Electrification incentives create complex sequencing decisions.
projects.differentiator: It optimizes packages and sequences while exposing physical assumptions and uncertainty.
projects.local_first_mvp: Model a synthetic small home and compare heat pump before/after envelope improvements across open weather files.
projects.demo_story: Air sealing first enables a smaller heat pump and beats either measure alone.
projects.test_strategy: Energy balance; reference archetypes; solver checks; sensitivity ranges.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled archetypes and open weather files; no vendor API.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Planning estimate only; combustion, electrical, and structural work needs qualified professionals.

projects.name: Personal Memory Provenance Index
projects.one_sentence: A private timeline that links local notes, files, calendar exports, and screenshots into source-grounded recall without uploading them.
projects.concrete_problem: People remember fragments but cannot reconstruct where a decision or fact came from.
projects.why_now: Personal data is abundant while trustworthy recall remains fragmented across apps.
projects.differentiator: Answers are temporal hypotheses with exact evidence and confidence, never uncited generated memories.
projects.local_first_mvp: Index a bundled month of synthetic personal artifacts and answer five recall questions with exact source spans.
projects.demo_story: A vague memory of a promise resolves to the note and calendar change that document it.
projects.test_strategy: Synthetic ground-truth timelines; retrieval judgments; deletion propagation; encryption/lock tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled synthetic artifacts or user-selected local exports; optional local model.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Explicit source consent, rapid deletion, encryption, and no inference of sensitive traits.

projects.name: Query Plan Counterfactuals
projects.one_sentence: A query optimizer sandbox that explains plan choices and predicts how indexes or statistics would change them.
projects.concrete_problem: EXPLAIN shows a chosen plan but rarely teaches why alternatives lost or whether estimates are fragile.
projects.why_now: Managed databases hide internals while query performance remains a major cost driver.
projects.differentiator: Counterfactual statistics and hypothetical indexes can be tested without mutating a real database.
projects.local_first_mvp: Optimize TPC-H-like local queries, inject skew, and show a plan flip caused by a bad independence assumption.
projects.demo_story: One histogram correction replaces a catastrophic nested loop with a hash join.
projects.test_strategy: Exact small-query enumeration; known cost cases; estimator calibration; deterministic plans.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Generated/open benchmark data; no server required.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Cost predictions are educational estimates, not guaranteed production savings.

projects.name: Transit Reliability Replay
projects.one_sentence: A GTFS-based simulator that replays vehicle delays and tests holding, transfer, and headway-control policies.
projects.concrete_problem: On-time averages hide missed transfers, bunching, and rider-weighted reliability.
projects.why_now: Open transit schedules enable independent service-quality analysis.
projects.differentiator: Counterfactual operations are scored by passenger journeys and accessibility constraints, not vehicle punctuality alone.
projects.local_first_mvp: Run a small bundled network, inject one delayed bus, and compare hold-versus-no-hold on missed transfers.
projects.demo_story: Holding one bus worsens punctuality but halves rider-weighted delay by protecting a transfer.
projects.test_strategy: Toy network analytic cases; seeded simulation; schedule validation; policy invariants.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled/open GTFS files; no live API required.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Publish assumptions and avoid inferring individual rider behavior.

projects.name: Crash-Consistency Page Lab
projects.one_sentence: A page-store laboratory comparing WAL, shadow paging, and copy-on-write recovery under torn writes.
projects.concrete_problem: Database durability is difficult to learn without controlled crashes at individual write and flush boundaries.
projects.why_now: Embedded databases increasingly hold important local-first state.
projects.differentiator: A virtual block device can tear, reorder, or lose writes and produce the smallest corrupting trace.
projects.local_first_mvp: Insert records, crash at every I/O boundary, and compare recoverability of WAL and shadow-paging implementations.
projects.demo_story: One missing flush corrupts a naive store while the visualizer proves why WAL recovers.
projects.test_strategy: Exhaustive small crash points; model comparison; corruption fuzzing; recovery idempotence.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Generated pages on a local virtual disk.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Never points fault injection at real block devices.

projects.name: Offline CRDT Workspace
projects.one_sentence: A peer-to-peer structured notebook that merges text, lists, and movable blocks after arbitrarily long offline edits.
projects.concrete_problem: Offline collaboration demos often handle plain text but fail on block moves, deletions, and schema changes.
projects.why_now: Local-first software is resurging as users demand ownership and reliable offline behavior.
projects.differentiator: A merge inspector explains each resolved conflict and exposes metadata growth rather than hiding it.
projects.local_first_mvp: Edit the same nested document in two offline browser profiles, reconnect over localhost, and converge with an explainable merge trace.
projects.demo_story: Two laptops make conflicting moves while disconnected and later converge without a server or lost block.
projects.test_strategy: Property-test commutativity and convergence over shuffled operations; fuzz migrations; simulate long offline gaps.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: All documents and sync traffic remain local; synthetic fixtures only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Peer authorization and encrypted transport are required before use beyond a trusted LAN.

projects.name: SLO Burn-Rate Lab
projects.one_sentence: A simulator that designs multi-window alerts from traffic seasonality, error budgets, and incident objectives.
projects.concrete_problem: Teams copy alert thresholds without understanding detection speed, false positives, or low-traffic behavior.
projects.why_now: SLOs are widespread but alert quality still depends on fragile folklore.
projects.differentiator: It backtests candidate alerts against generated incidents and reports Pareto tradeoffs.
projects.local_first_mvp: Tune alerts for a synthetic API with daily seasonality and compare detection delay versus paging noise.
projects.demo_story: A popular rule misses a slow burn; an optimized paired window catches it without extra pages.
projects.test_strategy: Analytic cases; seeded Monte Carlo; rule mutation tests; deterministic export.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic time series; local CSV import optional.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Recommendations require validation against real operational context before paging humans.

projects.name: Adaptive Input Remapper
projects.one_sentence: A local input layer that converts noisy switch, keyboard, or pointer signals into reliable actions using personalized temporal filters.
projects.concrete_problem: Standard debounce settings cannot accommodate tremor, long presses, accidental repeats, or fatigue changes.
projects.why_now: Commodity sensors enable personalized access without specialized hardware.
projects.differentiator: An offline calibration session learns explainable per-action filters and exposes latency/error tradeoffs.
projects.local_first_mvp: Replay synthetic tremor traces, calibrate three actions, and reduce unintended activations under a latency ceiling.
projects.demo_story: A noisy double press becomes one reliable action while an intentional double press still works.
projects.test_strategy: Signal replay corpus; latency bounds; false activation metrics; fail-safe property tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic recordings and optional user-owned local input traces.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Always provide instant disable/reset and never adapt mappings invisibly.

projects.name: Budget-Aware Local Model Router
projects.one_sentence: A local inference router that selects models and decoding policies from measured quality, latency, memory, and energy envelopes.
projects.concrete_problem: One local model is rarely best for every task, yet routing based on model names ignores actual hardware behavior.
projects.why_now: Small specialized models can now outperform large defaults on narrow tasks.
projects.differentiator: Routing is calibrated from reproducible on-device benchmarks and can abstain when no candidate meets a constraint.
projects.local_first_mvp: Benchmark two tiny open models plus a scripted baseline on bundled tasks and route under latency and memory budgets.
projects.demo_story: A small model handles extraction in 200ms while a harder proof is routed to a slower model or abstained.
projects.test_strategy: Held-out routing accuracy; benchmark repeatability; constraint violation tests; baseline comparisons.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Tiny redistributable models or mock runtimes and open fixtures; no paid API.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Quality measurements are task-specific and should not imply general model safety.

projects.name: Distributed Systems Fault Tutor
projects.one_sentence: An executable teaching environment where learners predict invariants before injecting partitions, pauses, and reordered messages.
projects.concrete_problem: System-design courses discuss failures abstractly without forcing precise predictions.
projects.why_now: Distributed behavior is expected knowledge but difficult to practice safely.
projects.differentiator: Lessons grade invariant predictions against deterministic executions, not architecture-diagram vocabulary.
projects.local_first_mvp: Ship three lessons on retries, leases, and quorum reads with executable counterexamples.
projects.demo_story: A learner predicts exactly-once payment, injects a crash, and sees the duplicate causal path.
projects.test_strategy: Scenario determinism; invariant mutation; lesson completion studies; sandbox tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Pure local simulation.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Analytics are opt-in and local; avoid presenting one design pattern as universally correct.

projects.name: Incremental View Kernel
projects.one_sentence: A relational engine that updates materialized query results from deltas instead of recomputing them.
projects.concrete_problem: Interactive analytics repeatedly recomputes joins and aggregates after tiny source changes.
projects.why_now: Reactive applications need database-grade incremental computation locally.
projects.differentiator: A delta-plan visualizer proves which operators changed and compares work with full recomputation.
projects.local_first_mvp: Maintain a multi-join sales aggregate through inserts, updates, and deletes with byte-identical full-query checks.
projects.demo_story: One row update touches 12 maintained records instead of rescanning a million-row fixture.
projects.test_strategy: Differential full recomputation; algebra properties; randomized transactions; crash tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic tables and local storage.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Expose memory growth and unsupported query classes rather than silently recomputing.

projects.name: Offline Eval Corpus Forge
projects.one_sentence: A provenance-preserving tool that turns local failure traces into deduplicated, versioned, leakage-checked evaluation cases.
projects.concrete_problem: Evaluation sets quietly accumulate duplicates, train-test leakage, secrets, and ambiguous expected outcomes.
projects.why_now: Fast model iteration makes trustworthy regression data more valuable than one-off benchmark scores.
projects.differentiator: Every case retains derivation lineage, adjudication state, contamination fingerprints, and executable environment fixtures.
projects.local_first_mvp: Import bundled agent traces, redact seeded secrets, collapse variants, and export train/dev/test splits with a leakage report.
projects.demo_story: An impressive score drops after the forge discovers that 18 percent of test cases paraphrase training examples.
projects.test_strategy: Seeded leak corpus; redaction golden tests; dedupe precision/recall; deterministic split properties.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local traces and optional local embeddings; no hosted model.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Consent, licensing, and retention metadata are mandatory for imported human data.

projects.name: Patch Risk Mapper
projects.one_sentence: A local change analyzer that maps a diff to affected contracts, tests, owners, and runtime paths using repository evidence.
projects.concrete_problem: Line counts are a poor proxy for the blast radius of a code change.
projects.why_now: Higher change velocity makes targeted review and testing more valuable.
projects.differentiator: Risk is evidence-based and decomposed into graph reach, contract changes, test gaps, and historical co-change.
projects.local_first_mvp: Analyze a bundled Git history and show why a three-line serialization change outranks a 200-line isolated refactor.
projects.demo_story: The report finds an untested public contract reached by seven packages from a tiny patch.
projects.test_strategy: Seeded repositories; ablation tests; known-impact commits; scorer monotonicity properties.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local Git, source, and coverage files only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Scores support reviewer judgment and must not become automatic blame or performance metrics.

projects.name: Prompt Injection Fixture Lab
projects.one_sentence: A local benchmark generator for testing whether agents preserve instruction and data boundaries across hostile documents and tools.
projects.concrete_problem: Prompt-injection testing is often a handful of strings with no stateful consequences or coverage model.
projects.why_now: Agents increasingly consume untrusted content and possess consequential tools.
projects.differentiator: Fixtures encode attack preconditions, authority boundaries, canary objectives, and observable tool-side effects.
projects.local_first_mvp: Test a scripted or local-model document agent against 50 mutated injections and score unauthorized file and network attempts.
projects.demo_story: A defense blocks explicit attacks but fails a quoted-email variant that requests the same forbidden tool action.
projects.test_strategy: Mutation adequacy; deterministic sandbox effects; oracle agreement; regression corpus versioning.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Generated documents, mock tools, and optional local models; no secret.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Keep attack fixtures defensive, sandboxed, and free of deployable malware or real credentials.

projects.name: Secret History Exposure Planner
projects.one_sentence: A read-only Git forensic tool that maps leaked-secret reachability and produces a safe rotation and history-rewrite plan.
projects.concrete_problem: Finding a secret in Git does not reveal which refs, forks, releases, or caches may still expose it.
projects.why_now: Repository mirroring and automated indexing make even short-lived credential commits persistent.
projects.differentiator: It separates credential rotation urgency from optional history cleanup and never rewrites by default.
projects.local_first_mvp: Scan a synthetic repository containing staged leaks, identify every reachable blob and tag, and emit an ordered rotate-then-clean plan.
projects.demo_story: Two identical tokens receive different remediation plans because only one reached a signed release tag.
projects.test_strategy: Generated Git DAGs; detector precision corpus; pack/unpack parity; snapshot remediation plans.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Runs on local repositories and synthetic tokens; provider APIs are optional and disabled by default.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Never prints full secrets or performs destructive history rewriting; findings are encrypted or redacted.

projects.name: Auction Mechanism Laboratory
projects.one_sentence: A mechanism-design simulator comparing first-price, second-price, uniform, discriminatory, and combinatorial auctions.
projects.concrete_problem: Auction rules alter incentives and allocation quality in ways static examples cannot reveal.
projects.why_now: Auctions allocate ads, compute, energy, and public resources.
projects.differentiator: It searches strategic bidder populations and measures welfare, revenue, regret, and manipulability.
projects.local_first_mvp: Run four mechanisms against seeded value distributions and discover a bidder strategy with positive regret.
projects.demo_story: A revenue-leading mechanism loses after strategic adaptation, while another preserves welfare.
projects.test_strategy: Truthfulness properties; brute-force small allocations; seeded Monte Carlo; solver verification.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Generated bidder populations only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Do not facilitate collusion or deploy mechanisms without legal/fairness review.

projects.name: Counterexample Proof Coach
projects.one_sentence: A bounded model explorer that finds minimal counterexamples to student conjectures and links them to proof obligations.
projects.concrete_problem: Students struggle to see why a plausible discrete-math statement is false or which assumption is missing.
projects.why_now: Solver technology can provide precise feedback without generating opaque full solutions.
projects.differentiator: It returns the smallest structure and an interactive obligation trail, not a finished proof.
projects.local_first_mvp: Support graph/set relations and find minimal counterexamples for ten bundled conjectures.
projects.demo_story: One three-node graph reveals the exact missing connectivity assumption.
projects.test_strategy: Known theorem/counterexample suite; brute-force small-domain cross-check; minimization properties.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local solver and bundled exercises.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Hints should preserve learning goals and clearly state finite-domain limits.

projects.name: DNS Failure Workbench
projects.one_sentence: A local authoritative resolver lab for replaying caching, negative answers, delegation, and DNSSEC failure modes.
projects.concrete_problem: DNS incidents are hard to reproduce because caches and delegation state live across multiple actors.
projects.why_now: DNS remains a critical hidden dependency for service and identity systems.
projects.differentiator: A virtual clock and resolver graph make TTL and stale-cache behavior exactly replayable.
projects.local_first_mvp: Reproduce an expired delegation plus stale negative cache across three local servers and show recovery timing.
projects.demo_story: Fixing the record does not restore service until the workbench reveals a hidden negative TTL.
projects.test_strategy: RFC-derived vectors; virtual-time properties; malformed packet fuzzing; resolver differential tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Reserved local zones and generated keys only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Binds to loopback and excludes amplification/load-generation features.

projects.name: Fencing Token Lock Lab
projects.one_sentence: A lease service and resource emulator that demonstrates why distributed locks need monotonically increasing fencing tokens.
projects.concrete_problem: Teams incorrectly treat lease ownership as proof that a paused client can safely resume writes.
projects.why_now: Autoscaling and stop-the-world pauses make stale lock holders a recurring source of corruption.
projects.differentiator: The lab compares unsafe leases, fencing tokens, and quorum leases against identical adversarial schedules.
projects.local_first_mvp: Pause client A after lease acquisition, let client B acquire the next token, resume A, and show the resource rejecting A's stale write.
projects.demo_story: A corruption occurs under a naive lock and disappears when the same trace is rerun with fencing.
projects.test_strategy: Model-based state-machine tests; randomized clock drift; crash recovery checks; token monotonicity assertions.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Loopback processes and generated workloads only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Clearly labels the service educational until durability and deployment assumptions are independently audited.

projects.name: Passkey Protocol Lab
projects.one_sentence: A local WebAuthn relying party, authenticator emulator, and packet-level ceremony explainer for passkeys.
projects.concrete_problem: Passkey integrations fail around origins, counters, discoverable credentials, and recovery because ceremonies are opaque.
projects.why_now: Passkeys are replacing passwords, yet hands-on protocol tooling remains fragmented.
projects.differentiator: Each registration and assertion is decoded into verified bytes, trust decisions, and deliberately broken counterexamples.
projects.local_first_mvp: Register and authenticate with an emulated passkey, then replay the assertion against a wrong origin and explain the rejection byte by byte.
projects.demo_story: The user toggles one origin bit and sees exactly which signed field makes the replay invalid.
projects.test_strategy: Protocol conformance vectors; malformed CBOR fuzzing; replay/counter tests; browser integration tests on localhost.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Localhost TLS and generated test keys only; no identity provider.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: The software authenticator is educational and must not store real production credentials.

projects.name: Synthetic Fraud Ring Graph
projects.one_sentence: A temporal graph lab for detecting coordinated transaction rings while measuring investigator workload and false accusations.
projects.concrete_problem: Point fraud scores miss coordinated behavior, while graph rules can overflag innocent dense communities.
projects.why_now: Instant payments compress detection time and coordinated abuse is easier to automate.
projects.differentiator: A controllable generator provides exact ring ground truth and counterfactual innocent lookalikes.
projects.local_first_mvp: Generate 100,000 transactions with three ring types and compare rules against a local graph model.
projects.demo_story: A detector catches a ring but is rejected because it floods investigators with innocent payroll clusters.
projects.test_strategy: Exact ground truth; motif unit tests; temporal split; workload and subgroup metrics.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic data only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Never use synthetic performance to justify real adverse decisions; require human review and bias analysis.

projects.name: Tamper-Evident File Ledger
projects.one_sentence: A local evidence vault that seals file versions, metadata, and acquisition context into verifiable append-only checkpoints.
projects.concrete_problem: Researchers and incident responders need to show that evidence was not silently edited after collection.
projects.why_now: AI-generated and rapidly edited digital material makes provenance claims harder to trust.
projects.differentiator: It supports selective disclosure proofs for chosen files without exposing the rest of a collection.
projects.local_first_mvp: Seal a directory, alter one file and one timestamp, verify the original checkpoint, and generate a proof for a single untouched artifact.
projects.demo_story: A recipient verifies one document's history without receiving unrelated confidential files in the vault.
projects.test_strategy: Merkle proof properties; tamper mutation corpus; key-rotation fixtures; canonicalization cross-platform tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local files and generated signing keys only; external timestamping is optional.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Integrity proofs do not prove truth or lawful acquisition; metadata may itself be sensitive.

projects.name: Content-Addressed Backup Swarm
projects.one_sentence: A LAN backup engine with chunk deduplication, erasure coding, encrypted manifests, and repair after peer loss.
projects.concrete_problem: Households and labs have spare disks across machines but lack an inspectable way to pool them safely.
projects.why_now: Storage is abundant at the edge while cloud backup subscriptions and privacy concerns continue to grow.
projects.differentiator: It proves recoverability by continuously sampling and reconstructing encrypted chunks across ephemeral peers.
projects.local_first_mvp: Back up a directory across three local peer processes, delete one peer's store, reconstruct it, and restore a byte-identical tree.
projects.demo_story: The user destroys one simulated disk and watches the swarm prove and restore every missing chunk.
projects.test_strategy: Random file-tree generation; corruption injection; restore hash checks; property tests for chunk boundaries.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local files and loopback peers only; no cloud account.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Encryption keys are never transmitted to storage peers; destructive cleanup is confined to explicit test roots.

projects.name: Literature Contradiction Map
projects.one_sentence: A local evidence mapper that clusters studies by comparable claims, populations, methods, and apparently conflicting findings.
projects.concrete_problem: Search results flatten genuine contradictions together with differences in population or measurement.
projects.why_now: Publication volume makes manual evidence reconciliation increasingly difficult.
projects.differentiator: Contradictions are conditioned on structured study context and linked to exact excerpts.
projects.local_first_mvp: Map a bundled open mini-review and separate one true conflict from two population mismatches.
projects.demo_story: Two headlines disagree, but the map shows one studied children and the other adults with a different outcome.
projects.test_strategy: Expert-labeled mini corpus; span fidelity; contradiction precision; schema consistency.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled/open papers and optional local model.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Do not automate scientific conclusions; show uncertainty and licensing.

projects.name: Cognitive Load Reader
projects.one_sentence: A local document transformer that creates reversible reading views from syntactic complexity, definitions, and user-selected pacing constraints.
projects.concrete_problem: Dense interfaces and documents overload readers, while generic simplifiers erase nuance.
projects.why_now: On-device language analysis enables personalized assistance without uploading private text.
projects.differentiator: Every simplification is aligned to the original and users can inspect what was omitted or rephrased.
projects.local_first_mvp: Transform a bundled technical article into chunked and glossary views using rules plus an optional tiny local model.
projects.demo_story: A reader expands one simplified sentence to verify the original nuance without losing their place.
projects.test_strategy: Alignment goldens; factual preservation checklist; readability metrics; keyboard/screen-reader tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local documents and optional local model only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Never replace authoritative medical/legal text; always preserve exact original access.

projects.name: Local CI Resource Scheduler
projects.one_sentence: A dependency-aware test scheduler that packs CPU, memory, ports, and exclusive resources across a developer machine.
projects.concrete_problem: Local CI either runs serially or overloads the machine because tests have heterogeneous and hidden resource needs.
projects.why_now: Powerful local hardware can replace many slow remote feedback loops.
projects.differentiator: It learns resource envelopes from prior runs and schedules for minimal critical-path time under hard isolation constraints.
projects.local_first_mvp: Schedule 30 synthetic jobs with dependencies and memory spikes, beating naive parallel execution without exceeding a limit.
projects.demo_story: The same suite finishes faster while the laptop remains responsive and every resource decision is visible.
projects.test_strategy: Deterministic scheduler simulations; resource-limit assertions; adversarial job graphs; benchmark against FIFO.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local commands and synthetic jobs only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Commands run with the invoking user's authority; sandbox profiles and dry-run are prominent.

projects.name: Notification Attention Firewall
projects.one_sentence: A local event broker that batches, escalates, or suppresses notifications using explicit urgency, interruption, and recovery-cost policies.
projects.concrete_problem: Per-app notification toggles cannot reason about cross-app duplication, focus state, or genuinely urgent events.
projects.why_now: Notification volume grows as more tools compete for immediate attention.
projects.differentiator: Rules optimize interruption cost with a visible decision ledger and guaranteed delivery bounds.
projects.local_first_mvp: Replay 500 synthetic notifications through three focus profiles and prove urgent events meet delivery deadlines.
projects.demo_story: Six duplicate alerts collapse into one, while a medication reminder bypasses focus mode with an explanation.
